entities.summary: Pham Tuan (b. 1947-02-14, Quốc Tuấn) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Quốc Tuấn and Vietnam. Known in the fields of vietnam, military leaders & commanders, asia.
